pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 11.4.1 GRADE - APPROPRIATE PLAY: LESSONS LEARNT

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.4: Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What lessons can one learn from a play?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify and illustrate the lessons learnt from a play

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify and illustrate the lessons learnt from a play
   In simple words: practise until you can identify and illustrate the lessons learnt from a play. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt.
4. Show that you can: identify and illustrate the lessons learnt from a play

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 11.4.1 Grade - appropriate Play: Lessons learnt important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read different excerpts of a play,
2. Discuss lessons learnt and provide illustrations for each lesson identified,
3. Critical thinking: It is stimulated as the learner reads different excerpts of a play and elicits lessons learnt.
4. Critical thinking skill: It is nurtured as the learner analyses lessons identified in pairs and compiles them.
5. Kiswahili explores various issues in the play as a genre.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What lessons can one learn from a play?
2. Which issues are addressed in a play?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify and illustrate the lessons learnt from a play

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
